QuestionStmt.S: The direction cosines of the line $x - y + 2z = 5$ and $3x + y + z = 6$ are

Solution.S:
Normal vectors to the given planes are:

$$\vec{n_1} = \hat{i} - \hat{j} + 2\hat{k}, \quad \vec{n_2} = 3\hat{i} + \hat{j} + \hat{k}$$

The direction vector of the line of intersection is:

$$\vec{n} = \vec{n_1} \times \vec{n_2} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 1 & -1 & 2 \\ 3 & 1 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-1-2) - \hat{j}(1-6) + \hat{k}(1+3) = -3\hat{i} + 5\hat{j} + 4\hat{k}$$

Magnitude = $\sqrt{(-3)^2 + 5^2 + 4^2} = \sqrt{9 + 25 + 16} = \sqrt{50} = 5\sqrt{2}$.

Direction cosines are:

$$\frac{-3}{5\sqrt{2}}, \frac{5}{5\sqrt{2}}, \frac{4}{5\sqrt{2}}$$

Thus the correct option is A.
